Audience.description: Provide culture code using ISO-3166 country codes and ISO-639 language codes.  For example, for audience targeting United States (English) respondents, set countryCode to "US" and cultureCode to "en_US". Only single culture surveys can be created through API at this time.

Block.description: Block is a structural element of the questionnaire transparent to respondents.  A typical questionnaire consists of two predefined regular blocks: introduction page and main questionnaire content. Each block contains an array of elements, where each element is a question, media, or a nested blocks structure.  The latter is used for surveys with random assignment. Block precode is generated automatically - omit when creating a survey.

BlocksDefinition.description: BlocksDefinition is a wrapper around multiple blocks with meta information applicable to this blocks structure, such as randomization of elements, number of visible blocks for random assignment sections.

ContentElement.description: Structural element of the questionnaire visible to the respondents: questions, text, media elements, page breaks.  Custom precodes can be specified on survey creation and must be unique within the survey.

MediaData.description: Wrapper object for media elements in the survey. Only image and video elements are supported at this time.  The link to the resource under mediaUrl has to be publicly accessible.  Watermarks cannot be enabled for media elements embedded by a link - omit the property when creating the survey. Media element precode is generated automatically - omit when creating a survey.

QuestionnaireInfo.description: Global meta information on the questionnaire, such as internal name, logo, and category

QuestionnaireStructure.description: Outer wrapper on the questionnaire contents. Consists of several inner objects with the questionnaire meta information, blocks structure, logic, custom scripts, and basic configurations for respondent experience.
